summary: Enhance your skills with our Information Audit and Accountability Frameworks Training. Learn best practices to ensure compliance and improve data management.
lede: Information audits and accountability frameworks help professionals make records, decisions, and reported results traceable. For project and program managers, records and compliance staff, finance, procurement, HR, and governance teams, the course focuses on building dependable evidence into everyday processes. Participants practise mapping information flows, checking record quality and control gaps, linking reported results to source evidence, and using audit findings to plan corrective action.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who are routinely involved in managing records, reporting, controls, compliance, and governance.
audience: Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL) professionals
Compliance, risk, and internal control officers
modules: Foundations of Information Audits and Accountability
Mapping Information Flows and Evidence Trails
Managing Sensitive Information and Access Controls
Accountability in Procurement, Finance, and Asset Management
Handling Audit Findings and Corrective Action Plans
Accountability Frameworks for NGOs and Public Sector Programs
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of organizational processes and a role that involves managing records, compliance, or audits. Prior experience in governance or project management is beneficial but not mandatory.
